scope: Eight complete physical HOB cards and Clap! Snap! adventure face 5410. Focused author evidence only; full-set acceptance remains open.

cards.name: Great Ugly-Looking Goblin // Clap! Snap!
obligations: Paid adventure creates 2/2 Goblin Army; physical card exiles with creature permission.
Paid six-mana creature is 4/4; only own creatures with +1/+1 counters gain menace; source departure removes the grant.

cards.name: Down, Down to Goblin-town
obligations: Paid Saga enters with lore 1; chapter I targets opponent and chooses a nonland from revealed hand.
Chapter II amasses one; chapters III and IV each independently drain one; final chapter resolves before sacrifice.

cards.name: Bolg's Company
obligations: Paid 2/2 has haste only while controlling another Goblin.
Tap and sacrifice another own Goblin produces exactly black and red immediately; self/opponent costs rejected with rollback.

cards.name: Dáin's Company
obligations: Paid 2/2 gains lifelink from another own Dwarf and loses it on departure.
Private top four accepts Dwarf or Equipment, decline supported, remainder placed randomly below untouched top card.
Wrong filter/outside top-four rejected; representative raw/index/restore contract at owned private decision.

cards.name: Snowslope Hunter
obligations: Paid 2/3 sacrifices another creature or artifact; wrong kinds/self/opponent rejected.
Own turn and once-per-turn guards; permission belongs to controller, survives opposing turn and ends after controller next turn cleanup.
Real paid cast from exile succeeds.

cards.name: Old Thrush
obligations: Paid colorless 1/2 has flying and gains exactly two life regardless of optional search choice.
Decline preserves library; accepted basic-only search puts selected basic on top after shuffle.

cards.name: Lake-town Toymaker
obligations: Paid 3/4 triggers only at own combat after actual second draw.
Only another own creature can be selected; result is +3/+0 plus first strike until cleanup.
Departed/reentered target does not rebind.

cards.name: Cantankerous Keepers
obligations: Paid 4/3 costs 3G with two own Elves and an opposing Elf; opposing Elf does not reduce cost.
Mills exactly four and returns both Elf cards, leaving non-Elves and untouched library correctly placed.
keepers_follows_milled_elves_into_public_exile_replacement covers Rest in Peace under CR701.17c; typed behavior intentionally corrects XMage graveyard-only filter.

notes: No engine changes, no English parsing, no runtime model calls.
Integrator must register mod hob_existing_two and regenerate catalogue/module links.
Independent nonauthor final reviews and release acceptance belong to the assembled full-set candidate.

validation.format: rustfmt --check --edition 2024 on all owned Rust inputs passed
validation.notes: Canceled fmt and initial compile units were terminal before edits; required guards and immutable active inputs preserved. No simulation benchmark executed in this authoring cohort.
